title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
script:
ChatGPT now answers your questions with interactive visuals.
OpenAI is rolling out the feature alongside GPT-6.
Responses now combine text with diagrams, charts, and forms.
You can even use new tappable buttons inside the chat.
Would you use buttons in your chats?
